name: Jonathan Mann
tagline: THE SONG A DAY MAN · 7 days a week, every week, since January 1, 2009
bio: Writes, records and publishes a song every single day since Jan 1, 2009 — 6,400+ songs, Guinness World Record for most consecutive days writing a song. 'The Beeple of Music': every song an NFT in the Song A Day collection, stewarded by SongADAO, catalog Creative Commons. Ethereum history: invited by Aya Miyaguchi to Devcon 4 Prague 2018, where he minted the first tokenized song in history live on stage (B-U-I-D-L); Merge Song at Devcon 6 Bogotá opening ceremonies; The Coordination Song; ETHDenver 2025 kickoff. Node 007 because — in Shaka's words — '7 days a week Jonathan is making songs.'
quote: Jonathan Mann writes a song a day, forever.
songs_note: His songs live where they have always lived — the streak, the DAO, the Creative Commons catalog. Nothing is rehosted here without his blessing.
